label: PF Backlog 194
title: EPIC: Multi-modal / media orchestration (pluggable capability packs)
body:
## Problem / why
The pipeline is text-centric: the catalog reads media (image/audio/video/file) but the LLM client is
text-only, there are no media generators, and no media pipeline. So projects that involve creating
or editing media (images, video, voice, reels/movies) cannot be built. See docs/multimodal_orchestration.md.

## Goal & value
Make the pipeline modality-agnostic via PLUGGABLE capability packs, enabled per project when the idea
needs them (nothing extra for a plain app; image/video/audio/3D packs for media products).

## In scope (sub-items)
- BI-0186 multimodal LLM plumbing (attach image/audio/video parts)
- BI-0187 media ingest + segmentation/tiling + asset store
- BI-0188 generator-model adapters (open-weights image/video/audio)
- BI-0189 capability-pack registry + config + discovery->enablement (the pluggable switch)
- BI-0190 media agents (media-analyst/generator/editor/asset-librarian)
- BI-0191 media QA validators

## Out of scope
- Dashboard multi-modal I/O UI (BI-0134).

## Acceptance criteria
- A media project enables its pack; a non-media project is unchanged.
- Image/audio/video inputs reach the right models; media outputs can be generated + validated.

## Verification / test plan
- Per sub-item; end-to-end: idea -> pack enabled -> media generated + QA'd.

## Docs
- docs/multimodal_orchestration.md (capability landscape + pluggable architecture)
- docs/multimodal_selection_dynamic.md (WHERE/WHEN to decide models+capabilities)

analysis.implementation_strategy: EPIC - orchestrate sub-items BI-0186..BI-0191. Extend `core/llm_client` plumbing via multimodal parts (BI-0186), build ingest/segmentation on `core/media_context.py`, generators via `core/model_catalog.py` adapters (BI-0188), the pluggable switch on existing `core/capability_packs.py` + `config/capability-packs.json` (BI-0189), agents via `core/capability_bridge.py`/`core/pipeline_capabilities.py` (BI-0190), QA via `core/media_qa.py` (BI-0191). Core remains modality-agnostic; packs enable per project at discovery.
dependency_findings: BLOCKED_BY sub-items BI-0186, BI-0187, BI-0188, BI-0189, BI-0190, BI-0191 completing
RELATED BI-0192 (model/capability strategy gate) as the enablement trigger
conflict_findings: `core/model_catalog.py` touched by BI-0188 generators and BI-0195 plugin registry - partition provider adapter files
`config/model-catalog.json` shared with BI-0218 versioning - coordinate schema
duplication_findings: `capability_packs.py`, `capability-packs.json`, `media_qa.py`, `media_context.py` already exist - sub-items must EXTEND, not create new registries
BI-0189 owns the pack registry switch - avoid parallel registry work here
BI-0192 two-phase model selection overlaps pack enablement timing - align decision point
analysis.rationale: Epic with strong existing scaffolding: packs, media context, media QA, and catalog already exist, so this is extension around proven modules, not greenfield.
assumptions: docs/multimodal_orchestration.md defines the pluggable architecture already
Non-media projects take zero code-path changes when packs disabled
risks: Open-weights generator adapters have varying licenses and hardware requirements
Per-project pack gating may leak media paths into non-media projects if not isolated
Sub-item sprawl risks inconsistent modality abstractions
evidence: Candidate code already includes capability_packs.py, media_context.py, media_qa.py, model_catalog.py
Sub-item titles BI-0186..BI-0191 enumerate the work
missing_info: Which generator models/vendors are approved (license, cost, hosting)
Storage backend and size limits for the media asset store
Ordering/parallelism plan among the six sub-items
